reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Airbeld again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with the same account originally used for this integration. Your devices and sensors will be retained.

abort.missing_configuration: Authentication setup failed. Please restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.oauth_error: Authentication failed. Please try again or check your Airbeld account credentials.
abort.cannot_connect: The identity service is unavailable. Please try again later.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original Airbeld account. A different account cannot replace this integration.

duplicate_account.title: Duplicate Airbeld account
duplicate_account.description: This account is already configured in the same environment. Only the oldest integration entry is loaded. Remove the later duplicate entry from Devices & services.

unresolved_legacy.title: Legacy Airbeld devices could not be resolved

confirm.title: Remove unresolved legacy devices?
confirm.description: Legacy device IDs {ids} are no longer visible to this account. Remove this entry's unresolved devices and sensors from the registries? Cancel to retain them unavailable. Existing recorder history is not deleted.
